mechanism: Lock one recorder-style viewing interface over the entire film, then let one subject move through a compact route of clearly different everyday places. Each place contributes one small human action and one spatial clue; finish with a direct gesture into the lens so the fixed interface feels like a remembered recording rather than decorative graphics.

invariants.rule: Keep one original recorder interface visually stable for the whole sequence.
invariants.purpose: Binds separate places into one recording session.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the interface changes every shot, it becomes decorative motion graphics.

invariants.rule: Keep one subject and one observer relationship continuous across at least three places.
invariants.purpose: Turns location changes into a route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated people and places become a travel montage.

invariants.rule: Give each place one small readable action rather than a posed beauty shot.
invariants.purpose: Creates memory detail and human continuity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Pure posing makes the interface feel like a filter.

invariants.rule: Use one physical threshold or travel action between interior and exterior scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abrupt location swaps lose the feeling of an outing.

invariants.rule: End with a direct lens interaction that physically closes the recording.
invariants.purpose: Provides an intimate and causal endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: A fade without interaction does not complete the observer relationship.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
